text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning before a scheduled afternoon practice on the track,
a sudden heavy rainstorm, absent from any forecast, began to fall—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, look!
It's rain, a downpour! Yay!
choice_data_list: Y-You look pretty happy about that.
Y-You look pretty happy about that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, look!
It's raining, a total downpour! Yay!
choice_data_list: Y-You look pretty happy about that.
Y-You look pretty happy about that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, you were saying recently that you wanted
to have Rice train on heavy track conditions, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, remember how you said you wanted
Rice to train on heavy tracks recently?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And so, I had an idea. I thought if Rice prayed for "sunny skies,"
maybe it would rain instead...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I hung a ton of teru teru bozu in my roomand prayed every single day for sunny skies!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And then, look at this weather!
Now we can run on heavy ground this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had mixed feelings about whether to celebrate,
but seeing how happy she was, I decided to go along with her idea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, once the afternoon arrived—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The morning downpour cleared up as if it were a lie,
and the track had dried back to Firm condition...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No way…… And I thought it went so well……
Rice really is just no good……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, Rice Shower's mood will hit rock bottom!
In that case—
choice_data_list: I'm gonna pray for rain now!
I'm gonna pray for rain now!
Let's turn this sunny weather to our advantage instead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, Rice Shower's mood will hit rock bottom!
In that case—
choice_data_list: I'm gonna pray for rain now!
I'm gonna pray for rain now!
Let's turn this sunny weather to our advantage instead.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fweh!?
A-A rain-making ritual!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Brother...
What an incredible cheer...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Sister...
What an incredible voice...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Raaaaain!
Come oooooon!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You think so? I rarely ever shout like that,
so it's kind of embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But, this might actually be a little fun...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, doubling it as vocal training, the two of us spent time shouting on the empty track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though Rice Shower was tired,
we managed to keep her spirits from sinking."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Take advantage of this clear weather...?
What do you mean by that—"
choice_data_list: Let's study firm turf inside and out!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-Is it really okay to change it that much...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it really is...
in remarkably pristine condition, isn't it...?”
choice_data_list: Let's try to look on the bright side.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I'll think about it positively.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
It's clear and feels so nice out, too...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, I—
I want to train right now...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, I—
I want to train right now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Rice Shower's motivation
has made a fine recovery...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Rice Shower and I were able to
conduct training that made good use of the firm track.
